rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for an alarm clock.

example.english: I have an early shift tomorrow, so I’ll remember to set the alarm clock tonight.
example.traditional: 我聽朝要返早更，今晚記得校好個鬧鐘先。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 ziu1 jiu3 faan2 zou2 gaang1 gam1 maan5 gei3 dak1 haau6 hou2 go3 naau6 zung1 sin1
